texts.zh: 地层的中心位置是一座杂草丛生的通道，通向地下深处。由于多年前的构造变迁，这里荒草丛生，半埋在碎石中，难以通行，清理通道将是一项艰巨的任务。
texts.en: At the very heart of the formation lies an overgrown processional entrance leading deep underground. Choked with vegetation and half-buried in rubble from some tectonic shift ages past, the going is very hard, and clearing the passageway will be quite an undertaking.

texts.zh:
穿过坍塌的入口后，沿着隧道便可深入地下，尽管年代久远，但其构造却堪称完美。走到地下几公里处，前方豁然开朗，一个巨大的、完美的球形房间出现在眼前。在房间的正中央悬浮着一个神秘的外星装置：一块半透明的琥珀色立方体，六面都刻有复杂的外星图案。触摸碑文会使正方体散发出有节奏的光脉冲。

房间里或谜盒上没有任何已知的语言、代码或数学方程的痕迹，但可以相当有把握地认为这个盒子是某种谜题。
texts.en:
Once past the collapsed entrance, a tunnel bores deep into the earth, architecturally flawless despite its age. Kilometers down, it opens into a massive, perfectly spherical chamber. Floating in a suspension field at the very center is an inscrutable alien device: a semi-opaque, amber-tinted cube with intricate alien patterns inscribed on all six sides. Touching the inscriptions causes rhythmic pulses of light to be emitted from the cube.

There is no trace of any known language, code, or mathematical equation in the chamber or on the puzzle box itself, but it is fairly safe to assume that the box is a riddle of some kind.

texts.zh:
谜盒上的图案原来是物理学中描述的各种力的视觉抽象。在这一发现之后，解谜就变得很简单了。

在通过触控面板进行解锁后不久，这个谜盒就分解成闪烁的白色尘埃。片刻之后，高潮降临，整个会议厅开始轰隆作响，一块隐藏的墙板移到一边，出现了一间可称之为古代外星图书馆的密室，其藏品为最前沿的理论物理知识。

科学部门将为这一发现忙碌数年！
texts.en:
The patterns on the puzzle box turned out to be visual abstractions of various forces described in physics. After that revelation, solving the puzzle box was a simple matter.

Moments after unlocking the combination of tactile inputs required, the puzzle box disintegrated into flickering motes of incandescent dust. The event was fairly anti-climactic until moments later, the whole chamber started to rumble, and a hidden wall panel moved aside to reveal what could best be described as an ancient alien library of highly advanced theoretical physics.

The science division will be kept busy with this find for years!

texts.zh:
虽然非常抽象，但我们最终发现谜盒表面所刻画的图案竟然是我们所处的恒星星座。令人不安的是，刻画星座的视角处于我们的星系之外，因此图案也显得有些隐晦艰涩。一旦我们察觉到这一点，打开盒子便是手到擒来了。实际上，它的的确确就是一张地图。

当这个谜盒被解开，它就会投影出一个邻近恒星系统的全息影像，影像的焦点处于外部环带的一处特殊地点。远距离观测显示该处是一片异常密集的岩石碎片群，其中一些碎片的大小与甚至与大陆相当。经过仔细检查，这些碎片是一个完整星球的残骸，不知何故在许多亿年前就已经被摧毁了。

无论那里曾经存在过什么，指引着谜盒这一伟大造物导向的那个地方，都已经成为了过眼云烟归于虚无了。
texts.en:
Although wildly abstract, the patterns on the puzzle box's surface turned out to be stellar constellations. This was not immediately apparent because the viewpoint from which the constellations were depicted originates, ominously, from outside our own galaxy. Once that discovery had been made, unlocking the box was easy. It is, in fact, a map.

Once the puzzle box was solved, it lit up to reveal a holographic display of a nearby star system, focusing on a particular location in the outer belt. Observations of that point revealed an unusually dense cluster of rocky debris, some of it continental in size. Upon inspection it turned out to be the remaining fragments of an entire planet that was somehow destroyed many eons ago.

Whatever was there, and whatever inspired the construction of this grand edifice pointing the way, is long gone.

texts.zh:
解这个谜盒的确是一件相当痛苦的事。仅仅调整图样本身是不够的——它们还必须按照特定的顺序来解决，每一步的计算都会改变所有后续步骤的计算，排列方式几乎无穷无尽。我们在回溯上花了大量时间，但最后，谜盒解锁了。

当最后一个图样在咔嚓声中归位，谜盒爆裂成数百万个小光点。光亮在空中狂舞了片刻，随后汇聚成某种未知语言的文字。奇怪的是，所有目击这一事件的人似乎都不用知晓文字的含义就本能地理解了这一信息。在光亮永远黯淡之前，文字维持了几秒钟的时间，文字写道：你通过了最终试炼。我们将作出相应的回应。
texts.en:
Solving the puzzle box turned out to be quite an ordeal. Aligning the patterns themselves was not enough - they also had to be solved in a particular order, with the calculations of each step altering those of all subsequent ones, in nearly endless permutations. There was much time-consuming backtracking, but in the end, it was unlocked.

As the last pattern clicked into place, the puzzle box exploded into millions of tiny points of light. The lights danced madly in the air for a few moments, before coalescing to create words in some unknown language. Oddly, all witnesses to this event seemed to instinctively understand the message without knowing the words. For a few seconds, before flickering out forever, it read: You have passed the Trial. We shall respond accordingly.

# 轨道目标 / Target from Orbit

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重100，只出现在不宜居的常规星球上。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 100 on uninhabitable regular planets.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

轨道上清晰可见一个数千公里的人造图形，中心通往地下；球形大厅里悬浮着一个谜之盒，解谜结果随机三选一。

1. 一路向下：清理被植被和碎石堵塞的仪式通道
2. 琥珀谜盒：球形大厅中央悬浮着琥珀谜之盒

A construct thousands of kilometres wide points to an entrance; a puzzle box floats in a spherical hall below, and solving it gives one of three random endings.

1. Down We Go: clearing an overgrown, collapsed processional entrance
2. The Amber Puzzle Box: the amber puzzle box in a spherical chamber

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 智慧宝藏 / Treasure of the Wise：图案是物理学的抽象，解开后得到宝藏 / the patterns encode physics; solving it releases a treasure
- 索图无路 / Map to Nowhere：图案是从银河系外看到的星座——一张通往无处的地图 / the patterns are constellations seen from outside the galaxy — a map to nowhere
- 古老认可 / Ancient Approval：漫长的计算后，古老的装置表示认可 / after endless permutations the ancient device signals approval

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用本遗址专属的事件池 site_target_from_orbit_random_events。 / Failed rolls draw from this site's own pool site_target_from_orbit_random_events.
